meta.curriculumName: IB Economics SL — Units 3-4: International & Development

topics.title: Trade Theory and Policy
keyFacts: Comparative advantage: produce where opportunity cost is lowest
Protectionism tools: tariffs, quotas, subsidies, administrative barriers
Free trade area vs customs union vs common market vs economic union

topics.title: Exchange Rates
keyFacts: Appreciation: currency strengthens → imports cheaper, exports expensive → current account worsens
Marshall-Lerner condition: devaluation improves BoP if PED_x + PED_m > 1
J-curve effect: BoP worsens before improving after depreciation

topics.title: Economic Development
keyFacts: Development ≠ Growth: development includes human well-being
HDI: life expectancy, education, GNI per capita
Strategies: import substitution vs export promotion, FDI, aid, trade
